home.title: Hear the mix, your way.
home.description: Reduce vocals from device audio locally, with direct control over isolation quality and latency.

processing.backendComponentRequired: The Windows system-audio component is not installed yet. GitHub Actions development bundles include it under system-audio; install it, set the virtual output as the Windows default, then restart Voxveil.
processing.backendUnsupported: System-audio processing is not implemented for this platform build yet.
processing.backendFaulted: The audio backend failed to initialize. Processing was disabled so device audio remains unmodified.
processing.backendRoutingRequired: Set Voxveil Virtual Audio as the Windows default output, then return to Voxveil. Processed audio will be relayed to the physical output shown below.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Classic DSP works without a model. Optional AI separation can improve isolation when a commercially cleared local model is installed.
engine.dspDescription: Ultra-light center and spectral vocal suppression.
engine.aiDescription: Optional local two-stem separation. The model is downloaded only after explicit consent.
engine.licenseRule: Voxveil does not bundle AI weights. Only approved, hash-pinned model downloads are offered after explicit user consent.
engine.modelStorage: The AI model is not bundled with Voxveil. It is stored only in Voxveil application data on this device.
engine.consentDescription: Voxveil will download {{name}} (~{{size}} MB) only after you agree. The file is stored in application data and verified before installation.
engine.networkNotice: This one-time download contacts the model host. No audio, analytics, telemetry, or diagnostics are uploaded.
engine.consentAgreement: I agree to download and use this third-party model under its {{license}} license.

modelError.status: Model status could not be read.
modelError.download: Model download or integrity verification failed.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Process the complete device mix or select individual applications. Communication audio remains bypassed by default.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Send one processed stream to physical playback, the virtual endpoint, or both without running separation twice.

settings.description: Voxveil keeps configuration, language resources, processing and diagnostics on this device.
